grandparents_cupboard.reason: Eggs, feta, runner beans, spring onions, tomatoes, bread and salad are all plain home ingredients.

supermarket.reason: Every item is an everyday Tesco purchase at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: An ovenproof frying pan, a bowl and a whisk are ordinary kit, and a baked frittata is well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: Eight eggs with 300g beans and 100g feta, baked at 200°C for 15 minutes, gives a set frittata that serves four with bread and salad.

honest_times.reason: Stringing and slicing the beans, slicing the onions, halving the tomatoes and about seven minutes of frying fit believably in 18 minutes, and the 15-minute bake matches the cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the basil and chilli flakes, appears in the steps, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: Runner beans are at their peak in late September and form the bulk of the frittata rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: Short, clear British instructions with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, vegetables and feta with bread and salad make a proper family dinner.
